label: Conjunction / disjunction query (Search)
type: an AND/OR compound query over sub-queries. The `+` (MUST) operator in query-string syntax is the conjunction shorthand.
evidence: Using conjunction (AND) queries can help make the search faster. In a query string, you can do this by using the + operator (MUST).
You must use compound query arrays to run a boolean query, but you can use a compound query array outside of a boolean query.
relates_to_competency_question: Can a Search query require that a document match several sub-queries at once, and what is the query-string shorthand for that?
